question: Should OpenClaw add a core child-visible pre-timeout warning/grace contract for sub-agent runs, and what config/tool surface should own it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but a safe fix requires product choices about public config/API naming, defaults, per-spawn overrides, and native plus ACP delivery semantics.

options.title: Define Core Warning Contract
options.body: Add a documented config-level grace setting, optionally a carefully named per-spawn override, and cover native plus ACP warning delivery with lifecycle tests.

options.title: Focus On Post-Timeout Recovery
options.body: Decline pre-timeout child warnings for now and put the work into timeout notification, durable completion delivery, and recovery issues.

options.title: Document Prompt Checkpointing
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged and document operator prompting/checkpoint guidance instead of adding a new config or warning path.

recommendation.title: Define Core Warning Contract
recommendation.body: Add a documented config-level grace setting, optionally a carefully named per-spawn override, and cover native plus ACP warning delivery with lifecycle tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent sub-agent lifecycle work and prior review context make this the best available owner for the product/API decision.
